title: Menu dispatch with a switch expression
prompt: Implement `String dispatch(String command)` using a **switch expression** (arrow form): `"start"` → `"running"`, `"stop"` → `"stopped"`, `"pause"` → `"paused"`, and any other command → `"unknown: "` plus the command itself.

tests.name: known commands
tests.hint: Map each known command to its state word.

tests.name: unknown commands
tests.hint: default arm handles everything else, echoing the input.
